title: Morty's New Family Won't Let Go Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty has found a family that wants him to stay, but their welcome comes with a terrifying condition. The father explains that this is not his Morty; his own son died after falling from a climb. Still, he hugs Morty and says he loves him just the same. Then the warmth turns into a test. Morty says he needs a resurrection machine, and the father challenges him to destroy the strange device in his hands. Then he tells Morty to do it. But why would anyone destroy the only way home? The father insists this is not one of Morty's adventures. It can be his life. Then he asks what Morty could possibly need that this family cannot provide. The device is still in Morty's hands. Will Morty break the only way home?

series.summary: Morty is welcomed by a family whose lost son he resembles, then pressured to destroy his way home.
